items.prompt: A snowy yard of a small forest school in winter seen through a classroom window frosted at the edges: children in coats playing in the snow, tall dark firs behind, a single bird on the fence.

alt.ru: Заснеженный двор маленькой лесной школы сквозь окно с инеем по краям: дети в пальто играют в снегу, за ними тёмные ели, на заборе одна птица.
alt.en: The snowy yard of a small forest school seen through a window frosted at the edges: children in coats playing in the snow, dark firs behind, one bird on the fence.
alt.pt: O pátio com neve de uma pequena escola na floresta visto por uma janela gelada nas bordas: crianças de casaco a brincar, abetos escuros atrás, um pássaro na cerca.
alt.es: El patio nevado de una pequeña escuela del bosque visto por una ventana escarchada en los bordes: niños con abrigo jugando, abetos oscuros detrás, un pájaro en la valla.
